name: add
title: routes.add
lead: From one dimension to another: standing `ticks` ticks in `block`, or only by `player:travel` without a trigger; arriving at `placement` or the destination's spawn.
signature: routes.add(route: { from: string, to: string, trigger: { block: string, ticks: number ? }?, placement: Vec3 ? })

params.name: route
params.type: { from: string , to: string , trigger: { block: string , ticks: number ? }?, placement: Vec3 ? }

usedIn.quote: routes.add{ from = "overworld", to = "dungeon", trigger = { block = "light_blue_carpet", ticks = 1 }, placement = { x = 0.5, y = 65, z = 0.5 } }
routes.add{ from = "dungeon", to = "overworld" }  -- no trigger: only player:travel takes it
